lines.t: Soft haze comes above the bay, quiet hearts forget the fray
I turn off the noise inside and watch the waves collide
Morning hums a gentle tune
Sunlight melts a silver moon
Every breath a sacred star
Stillness anchors every part
The world feels far yet close to grace
I find your calm in every space
I let the silence settle in
This is where peace begins
I don't need to chase the sound Heaven's rhythm all around
Every motion slows within This is where peace begins
Leaves drift low, the hours pass
Sunlight dancing through the glass
Rest feels like an open door
I'm not running anymore
More ocean breeze and drifting sail
Time unfolding in your air
Gentle whispers calm the skin
This is where peace begins
No way to prove, no rush to try
The highest grace is simply why
I'm here, I breathe, I let you in
This is where peace begins
Evening paints the sky with rest
Colors fade but I am blessed
Night songs rise, the stars appear
I know your presence lingers near
Every heartbeat soft and slow Every breath reminds me you know
Love restores what fear had then This is where peace begins
I don't need to chase this sound Heaven's rhythm all around
Every motion slows within
I'm home again where peace begins
Grace like rain, still and white
Calm waves meet the rising tide
All I am, I let it in
And this is where peace begins
Thank you.
